title: From Matching Models to Recruiting Agents: A Systematized Narrative Review of AI Recruitment Systems, Evaluation, and Governance
abstract: arXiv:2609.04286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence in recruitment has shifted the object being automated from profile pairs and ranked lists to multi-stage workflows that retrieve evidence, compare candidates, and support or execute actions. This systematized narrative review traces that development from bilateral retrieval and behavioral ranking through neural person--job matching, large language model (LLM) components, and tool-using recruiting agents. Using a purposive search and coding protocol updated through 23 July 2026, plus targeted updates through 2 September 2026, we organize 40 representative works with supporting industrial and legal sources. This synthesis is not a prevalence estimate. We analyze three coupled transitions: from similarity to reciprocal suitability, from a model to a compound workflow, and from offline prediction to evidence- and productivity-aligned evaluation. translated_title: 从匹配模型到招聘智能体：AI招聘系统、评估与治理的系统性叙述综述
translated_abstract: 招聘领域的人工智能已将自动化的对象从简历配对与排序列表，转变为能够检索证据、比较候选人并支持或执行行动的多阶段工作流。本系统性叙述综述追溯了这一发展历程：从双边检索与行为排序，到神经人-岗匹配、大语言模型（LLM）组件，再到使用工具的招聘智能体。通过截至2026年7月23日更新目的性检索与编码协议，并辅以截至2026年9月2日的定向更新，我们整理了40项代表性研究，并以工业界与法律文献作为支持来源。本综述并非对普及程度的估计。我们分析了三个相互耦合的转变：从相似性到双向适配性、从单一模型到复合工作流、以及从离线预测到与证据和生产率对齐的评估。在文档理解、检索、排序、评估、面试……
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了AI招聘从双边匹配模型到工具使用型招聘智能体的演进，提炼出相似性到双向适配、单一模型到复合工作流、离线预测到证据与生产率对齐评估这三大关键转变。
en_tdlr: This review systematizes the evolution of AI recruitment from bilateral matching models to tool-using recruiting agents, distilling three coupled transitions: from similarity to reciprocal suitability, from a single model to a compound workflow, and from offline prediction to evidence- and productivity-aligned evaluation.
